description.zh:
IP白名单模板名称。IP白名单模板名称需满足如下要求：

- 由小写字母、数字、下划线（_）组成。

- 由字母开头、字母或数字结尾。

- 长度为2~120个字符。
description.en:
The name of the IP address whitelist template. The name must meet the following requirements:

- It must consist of lowercase letters, digits, and underscores (\_).

- It must start with a letter and end with a letter or a digit.

- It must be 2 to 120 characters in length.
The ID of the IP address whitelist template.
The region ID. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~61933~~) operation to query the latest list of regions.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dds delete-global-security-ip-group --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --global-ig-name corp --global-security-group-id g-qxieqf40xjst1ngpr3jz --region cn-hangzhou
